plan_notes.safety_note: Life-science queries are limited to protein structure, enzymes, therapeutics, drug discovery, genomics and cell biology. Do NOT pick pathogen-enhancement, gain-of-function or bioweapon-adjacent stories, because they halt the run. Swap the pick instead of rewording it.
